<mxfile host="Electron" scale="0.75" border="15"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="fgkWyab_I-0wM23kDwcm"> <mxGraphModel dx="1761" dy="789" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart LR

 %% ==========================================
 %% CROSS-INSTITUTIONAL ACTOR
 %% ==========================================

 CUSTOMER[\"CUSTOMER\"]


 %% ==========================================
 %% ANANSE TELECOM DOMAIN
 %% ==========================================

 subgraph ANANSE[\"ANANSE TELECOM\"]
 WALLET[\"WALLET\"]
 TRANSACTION[\"TRANSACTION\"]
 end


 %% ==========================================
 %% SIKACREDIT DOMAIN
 %% ==========================================

 subgraph SIKA[\"SIKACREDIT\"]
 LOAN[\"LOAN\"]
 end


 %% ==========================================
 %% OMAN REMIT DOMAIN
 %% ==========================================

 subgraph OMAN[\"OMAN REMIT\"]
 REMITTANCE[\"REMITTANCE\"]
 BENEFICIARY[\"BENEFICIARY FINANCIAL POSITION\"]
 end


 %% ==========================================
 %% OCB ANALYTICAL REPRESENTATION
 %% ==========================================

 subgraph OCB[\"OCB ANALYTICAL REPRESENTATION\"]
 LEDGER_ENTRY[\"LEDGER ENTRY\"]
 end


 %% ==========================================
 %% CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIPS
 %% ==========================================

 CUSTOMER -->|\"associated with\"| WALLET
 CUSTOMER -->|\"participates in\"| LOAN
 CUSTOMER -->|\"participates in\"| REMITTANCE


 %% ==========================================
 %% ANANSE RELATIONSHIPS
 %% ==========================================

 WALLET -->|\"participates in\"| TRANSACTION


 %% ==========================================
 %% OMAN REMIT RELATIONSHIPS
 %% ==========================================

 REMITTANCE -->|\"relates to\"| BENEFICIARY


 %% ==========================================
 %% ACCOUNTING CONSEQUENCES
 %% ==========================================

 TRANSACTION -->|\"may give rise to accounting consequence\"| LEDGER_ENTRY
 LOAN -->|\"may give rise to accounting consequence\"| LEDGER_ENTRY
 REMITTANCE -->|\"may give rise to accounting consequence\"| LEDGER_ENTRY


 %% ==========================================
 %% MODEL-LEVEL PRINCIPLES
 %% ==========================================

 NOTE1[\"CUSTOMER PRINCIPLE<br/><br/>Customer is the cross-institutional actor.<br/>Institutions remain operationally independent.\"]

 NOTE2[\"INSTITUTIONAL OWNERSHIP PRINCIPLE<br/><br/>Institutional financial objects remain institution-owned.<br/>OCB observes and resolves them.<br/>Their financial consequences can be represented<br/>in OCB's analytical ledger model.\"]

 NOTE3[\"LEDGER REPRESENTATION PRINCIPLE<br/><br/>Ledger Entry records accounting consequences<br/>arising from authoritative financial activity.<br/>It does not replace the originating financial object or event.\"]

 NOTE4[\"INSTITUTIONAL BOUNDARY PRINCIPLE<br/><br/>No shared accounts, databases, ledgers,<br/>or operational infrastructure are assumed.\"]",
 "config": null

div.div:
CUSTOMER PRINCIPLE
Customer is the cross-institutional actor.
Institutions remain operationally independent.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 462px; height: 1px; padding-top: 684px; margin-left: 798px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #333333;

display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', Verdana, Arial, sans-serif; color: light-dark(#333333, #cccccc); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
INSTITUTIONAL OWNERSHIP PRINCIPLE
Institutional financial objects remain institution-owned.
OCB observes and resolves them.
Their financial consequences can be represented
in OCB's analytical ledger model.

div.div:
LEDGER REPRESENTATION PRINCIPLE
Ledger Entry records accounting consequences
arising from authoritative financial activity.
It does not replace the originating financial object or event.

div.div:
INSTITUTIONAL BOUNDARY PRINCIPLE
No shared accounts, databases, ledgers,
or operational infrastructure are assumed.
